title: Terms of Service
metaDescription: The terms that apply when you use {siteName}. Plain language rules covering acceptable use, intellectual property, warranties and liability.
intro: These terms cover your use of {siteName} at {siteUrl}. By using the site you agree to them. They are written in ordinary language on purpose, because terms nobody can read protect nobody.
If you disagree with any part of these terms, the remedy is simple: stop using the site. Nothing here requires an account, so there is nothing to cancel.

Do not attempt to strip out, hide or interfere with any advertising that funds the service.
You are responsible for whatever you put into our tools and for what you do with the results.

Because we never receive your content, we cannot recover it for you either. If you generate a password and lose it, or close a tab before copying your result, that data is gone. Save anything important before you navigate away.
